old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-hbz1","title":"Rust LinkLayer accepts caller-forged peer IID aliases","description":"Security review P2. rust/lichen-link/src/identity.rs exposes PeerIdentity.pubkey and .iid publicly, while LinkLayer::add_peer in link_layer.rs indexes and later returns that caller-supplied IID without verifying iid_from_pubkey(pubkey). A caller can register an inconsistent {pubkey, iid}; a valid frame signature under that public key is then elevated to AuthenticatedFrame whose sender IID is the forged alias, and upper layers consume it for source/routing authority. Make PeerIdentity construction invariant-preserving (private fields and/or validate in add_peer), reject inconsistent identities before state mutation, and add negative tests proving a valid signature cannot acquire a non-derived IID.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:19:33.309787Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:19:33.309787Z"}
